+"""Smoke test for PL-01 (mdata.load_prices): the real steps end to end on a small CSV."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from mdata import Prices, load_prices
+
+CSV = """date,ticker,close
+2024-03-04,BBB,25.5
+2024-03-01,AAA,40.0
+2024-03-01,BBB,25.0
+2024-03-04,AAA,40.4
+2024-03-05,AAA,40.602
+2024-03-05,BBB,
+2024-03-06,AAA,41.0
+2024-03-06,BBB,24.7
+2024-03-06,CCC,9.0
+"""
+
+
+def _write_csv(tmp_path: Path) -> Path:
+    path = tmp_path / "prices.csv"
+    path.write_text(CSV, encoding="utf-8")
+    return path
+
+
+def test_load_prices_runs_read_validate_align(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    prices = load_prices(_write_csv(tmp_path), tickers=["AAA", "BBB"])
+
+    assert prices == Prices(
+        dates=("2024-03-01", "2024-03-04", "2024-03-06"),
+        tickers=("AAA", "BBB"),
+        closes={"AAA": (40.0, 40.4, 41.0), "BBB": (25.0, 25.5, 24.7)},
+    )
+
+
+def test_load_prices_all_tickers_keeps_only_shared_dates(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    prices = load_prices(str(_write_csv(tmp_path)))
